job.job_description:
Design, develop, and maintain RAG-based AI systems using Python and Azure AI services.
Build backend services using FastAPI, Flask, and Quart, with an emphasis on modular, scalable design.
Develop interactive UIs using React, npm, and Next.js.
Implement and optimize AI workflows using Azure OpenAI (LLMs), Azure AI Search, Cosmos DB, Storage Accounts, and related Azure-native components.
Design and build AI agents, including autonomous task agents, tool-using agents, and LLM function-calling architectures.
Write clean, maintainable, and efficient Python code for data ingestion, embedding pipelines, prompt flows, vector interactions, and retrieval logic.
Participate in architecture discussions to design fault-tolerant, production-grade AI systems.
Contribute to best practices related to observability, performance, scalability, and CI/CD.
Collaborate cross-functionally with product and cloud engineering teams to implement new features.
Contribute to Java-based services built using Spring Boot as part of the broader platform ecosystem.
